sentences.text: Sky UK Limited -LRB- formerly British Sky Broadcasting and BSkyB -RRB- is a telecommunications company which serves the United Kingdom .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom
Sky provides television and broadband internet services , fixed line and mobile telephone services to consumers and businesses in the United Kingdom .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom
pay-TV broadcaster with 11 million customers as of 2015 .
It was the UK 's most popular digital TV service until it was overtaken by Freeview in April 2007 .	Freeview	Freeview (UK)
Its corporate headquarters are in Isleworth .	Isleworth	Isleworth

Formed in November 1990 by the equal merger of Sky Television and British Satellite Broadcasting , Sky became the UK 's largest digital subscription television company .	Satellite	Satellite television	Sky Television	Sky Television plc	British Satellite Broadcasting	British Satellite Broadcasting

Following Sky 's 2014 acquisition of Sky Italia and a majority 90.04 % interest in Sky Deutschland in November 2014 , its holding company British Sky Broadcasting Group plc changed its name to Sky plc. .	Sky plc	Sky plc	Sky Italia	Sky Italia	Sky Deutschland	Sky Deutschland
The UK subsidiary 's name was changed from British Sky Broadcasting Limited to Sky UK Limited , and continues to trade as Sky .
Sky UK Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sky plc , with its current company directors being Andrew Griffith and Christopher Taylor .	Sky plc	Sky plc
Griffith acts as the Chief Financial Officer -LRB- CFO -RRB- and the Managing Director for the commercial businesses division .
